cards.image: 01-02-特工能力-卡舍津军士-能力卡.png
cards.text:
APL 移动豁免耐伤
卡舍津军士
3 6" 4+ 9
战术指挥 0AP
选择一名位于杀戮区内的己方卡舍津特工，随后为那名特工选择
一个熟练技巧效果（它将替代特工当前拥有的任何效果)，这个效
果将持续至下一个战略阶段的就绪步骤。被选择的效果可以与任何
特工已经拥有的熟练技巧效果叠加，但是不能是同样的效果。
作为替代，您可以选择不结算上述的效果。如果己方肃清扫荡标识
位于杀戮区内，那么您可以将其移除并再次部署。
该特工不能在敌方特工的控制范围内执行本行动。
精锐领袖：您使用熟练技巧战略计划时若该特工位于杀戮区，您可以
选择额外一条不同的熟练技巧。
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
KASRKIN SERGEANT
3 6" 4+ 9
TACTICAL COMMAND 0AP
Select one friendly KASRKIN operative, then select one
SKILL AT ARMS for that operative to have until the Ready
step of the next Strategy phase. This can be in addition to
any SKILL AT ARMS it already has, but they cannot be
the same.
Alternatively, instead of resolving the above effect, if your
Clearance Sweep marker is in the killzone, you can remove it
and place it again.
This operative cannot perform this action while within control
range of an enemy operative.
Veteran Leadership: Whenever this operative is in the killzone
and you use the SKILL AT ARMS STRATEGIC GAMBIT,
you can select one additional SKILL AT ARMS but they
cannot be the same.

cards.text:
APL 移动豁免耐伤
卡舍津战斗医疗兵
2 6" 4+ 8
名称攻击命中伤害武器规则
高能激光枪 4 3+ 3/4 -
枪托 3 4+ 2/3 -
医疗兵!：在每个转折点中，首次有另一名位于该特工 3" 内且可见的己方卡舍津特工将被残废时，如果该
特工或者那名特工不位于敌方特工的控制范围内，那么您可以使用此规则。若使用，那么那名己方特工不
会被残废，并且剩余 1 点耐伤并且直到行动结束前不能被残废。在那次行动结束后，那名己方特工可以立
即执行一次无消耗的冲刺行动，但是必须在该特工的控制范围内结束这次移动。直到该特工和那名特工的
下一次激活结束前，他们的 APL 属性各减少 1 点。如果您在那名特工的激活期间使用了本规则，那么那
次激活结束。您不能在该特工残废时，或者在该特工被选择成为一次射击行动的主要或次要目标时使用此
规则。
请继续阅读背面规则
卡舍津、帝国、星界军、医疗、战斗医疗兵 28
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
KASRKIN COMBAT MEDIC
2 6" 4+ 8
NAME ATK HIT DMG WR
Hot-shot lasgun 4 3+ 3/4 -
Gun butt 3 4+ 2/3 -
Medic!: The first time during each turning point that another friendly KASRKIN operative would be incapacitated while visible
to and within 3" of this operative, you can use this rule, providing neither this nor that operative is within control range of an enemy
operative. If you do, that friendly operative isn’t incapacitated, has 1 wound remaining and cannot be incapacitated for the remainder
of the action. After that action, that friendly operative can immediately perform a free Dash action, but must end that move within
this operative’s control range. Subtract 1 from this and that operative’s APL stats until the end of their next activations respectively,
and if this rule was used during that friendly operative’s activation, that activation ends. You cannot use this rule if this operative is
incapacitated, or if it’s a Shoot action and this operative would be a primary or secondary target.
RULES CONTINUE ON OTHER SIDE
KASRKIN , IMPERIUM, ASTRA MILITARUM, MEDIC, COMBAT MEDIC 28

热熔地雷：该特工携带有己方热熔地雷标识。该特
工可以对这枚标识执行拾取标识行动，并且每当该
特工对这枚标识执行放置标识行动时，该特工可以
在之后立即执行一次无消耗的冲刺行动。这枚标识
不能被放置在敌方特工的控制范围内（如果该特工
在携带这枚标识的期间残废，那么不要放置标识，

结束其执行的行动（若有)，就算行动的效果没有被
满足。如果那名特工因此不能被放置，那么移动最短
的距离来满足放置条件。请注意，该特工忽略此规则
的效果（该特工不会触发这枚标识，也不会受到其造

2 6" 4+ 8
NAME ATK HIT DMG WR

Melta Mine: This operative is carrying your Melta Mine marker. It
can perform the Pick Up Marker action on that marker, and
whenever it performs the Place Marker action on that marker,
it can immediately perform a free Dash action. That marker
cannot be placed within an enemy operative’s control range (if
this operative is incapacitated while carrying that marker and
that marker cannot be placed, it’s removed with this operative).
Proximity Mine: The first time your Melta Mine marker is within
another operative’s control range, remove that marker and inflict
2D6+3 damage on that operative; if it isn’t incapacitated, end
its action (if any), even if that action’s effects aren’t fulfilled. If
it cannot be placed, move it the minimum amount to do so. Note
that this operative is ignored for these effects (i.e. it cannot set it
off or take damage from that marker).
RULES CONTINUE ON OTHER SIDE
KASRKIN , IMPERIUM, ASTRA MILITARUM, DEMO-TROOPER 28

cards.text:
卡舍津
阵营规则
熟练技巧
卡舍津战士们会赶往任何需要他们支援的地
方。这些精兵们身经百战，意志坚定，并且
装备精良，是高度专业化的士兵，依靠着长
期的经验和坚定的意志来完成任务。
战略计划。为己方卡舍津特工选择一个熟练技
巧，效果持续到下一个战略阶段的就绪步骤。
熟练技巧选项将在单独的卡片上分别进行表示
cards.text_en:
KASRKIN
FACTION RULE
SKILL AT ARMS
The Kasrkin go where they are needed. Battle-hardened,
uncompromising and equipped with the best weapons
available, these elites pursue their objectives
with professionalism, hard-won experience and
rigid determination.
STRATEGIC GAMBIT. Select a SKILL AT ARMS for
friendly KASRKIN operatives to have until the
Ready step of the next Strategy phase.
SKILL AT ARMS OPTIONS ARE PRESENTED ON
THEIR OWN CARDS

cards.text:
卡舍津
阵营规则
熟练技巧
集火目标
卡舍津战士们在前进的同时建立相互重叠的
火网，敌人任何行动都将遭到致命弹幕的压
制攻击。
己方卡舍津特工的远程武器拥有“严重”武器
规则。
cards.text_en:
KASRKIN
FACTION RULE
SKILL AT ARMS
Light ’Em Up
Establishing overlapping fields of fire as they advance,
the Kasrkin react to any enemy movement with a lethal
volley of fire.
Friendly KASRKIN operatives’ ranged weapons
have the Severe weapon rule.

cards.text:
卡舍津
阵营规则
熟练技巧
迅速出击
卡舍津战士们以自身的强健体魄为傲，就算
是携带着重型战斗装备也能够在战场上迅速
穿梭。
每当一名己方卡舍津特工执行转移行动时，其
移动属性提升 1"。
cards.text_en:
KASRKIN
FACTION RULE
SKILL AT ARMS
Strike Fast
Kasrkin pride themselves upon their physical fitness
and can cover ground swiftly, even when carrying heavy
combat gear.
Whenever a friendly KASRKIN operative is
performing the Reposition action, add 1" to its
Move stat.

cards.text:
卡舍津
阵营规则
熟练技巧
沉着冷静
所有卡迪亚人都将一生致力于战争中。那些
被选中加入精英卡舍津部队的人则是其中最
为坚定的战士。
每当一名己方卡舍津特工进行近战或反击，或
者当一名特工对其进行射击时，如果在那个流
程中首次有一枚攻击骰对该特工造成了 3 点或
更多的普通伤害，那么那枚骰子造成的伤害减
少 1 点。
cards.text_en:
KASRKIN
FACTION RULE
SKILL AT ARMS
Ice In Your Veins
All Cadians are subjected to a lifetime of war. Those
chosen to join the ranks of the elite Kasrkin are amongst
the hardiest.
Whenever a friendly KASRKIN operative is
fighting or retaliating, or an operative is shooting
it, the first time an attack dice inflicts Normal
Dmg of 3 or more on this operative during that
sequence, that dice inflicts 1 less damage on it.

cards.text:
卡舍津
阵营规则
熟练技巧
为了卡迪亚！
每一位卡舍津战士都奋力维护着破灭家乡的
荣誉。
己方卡舍津特工近战武器的攻击属性提升 1 点
(最高提升至 4)。每当一名己方卡舍津特工进
行近战时，您在那次流程中进行的首次出击将造
成额外 1 点伤害。
cards.text_en:
KASRKIN
FACTION RULE
SKILL AT ARMS
For Cadia!
All Kasrkin strive to uphold the honour of their
dead homeworld.
Add 1 to the Atk stat of friendly KASRKIN
operatives’ melee weapons (to a maximum of
4). Whenever a friendly KASRKIN operative
is fighting, the first time you strike during that
sequence, inflict 1 additional damage.

cards.text:
卡舍津
阵营规则
迅速开火
卡舍津士兵经过残酷的训练，作战效率极
高，他们向敌人倾泻着威力强大的火力。
若己方卡舍津特工在激活中没有执行包含移动
的行动，则其可以在那次激活中执行两次射击行
动（戒备除外），不过在这些行动中必须选择激
光手枪，高能激光枪或高能激光手枪作为武器。
cards.text_en:
KASRKIN
FACTION RULE
RAPID FIRE
Ruthlessly drilled and murderously efficient, Kasrkin lay
down hails of high-powered fire against the foe.
Each friendly KASRKIN operative that doesn’t
perform an action in which it moves during
its activation can perform two Shoot actions
(excluding Guard) during that activation, but a
bolt pistol, hot-shot lasgun or hot-shot laspistol
must be selected for both of those actions.

cards.text:
卡舍津
标识/指示物指南
医疗兵扫描卡迪亚圣物
指示物指示物指示物
战术指挥肃清扫荡热熔地雷
指示物指示物标识
cards.text_en:
KASRKIN
MARKER/TOKEN GUIDE
Medic token Auspex Scan Relics of Cadia
token token
Tactical Clearance
Command Sweep marker
token
Melta Mine marker

cards.text:
卡舍津
战略计谋
灭敌弹幕
在将敌人包围之后，卡舍津战士们尝试通过
一次致命的齐射将目标歼灭。
每当一名己方卡舍津特工使用高能武器对无法
保留任何掩护豁免或者被扫描（参见侦察兵）的
特工进行射击时，那件武器拥有“关键穿刺 1”
武器规则，如果那件武器是高能齐射枪，则拥
有“穿刺 1”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
KASRKIN
STRATEGY PLOY
ELIMINATION PATTERN
Having already outmanoeuvred the foe, the Kasrkin
attempt to fell their target in a single volley.
Whenever a friendly KASRKIN operative is
shooting with a hot-shot weapon against an
operative that cannot retain any cover saves or
is being scanned (see RECON-TROOPER), that
weapon has the Piercing Crits 1 weapon rule, or
Piercing 1 instead if it’s a hot-shot volley gun.

cards.text:
卡舍津
战略计谋
利用掩体
卡舍津战士们早已习惯面对拥有数量和火力
优势的敌人，他们在交火时会利用掩体来躲
避敌人的攻击。
每当一名特工对拥有掩护的己方卡舍津特工进
行射击时，您可以重掷一枚自己的防御骰。
cards.text_en:
KASRKIN
STRATEGY PLOY
ENGAGE FROM COVER
Kasrkin are used to being outnumbered and outgunned,
using cover to avoid incoming fire as they engage.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
KASRKIN operative that’s in cover, you can
re-roll one of your defence dice.

cards.text:
卡舍津
战略计谋
肃清扫荡
卡舍津战士们以稳健的步伐向目标位置靠
近，将战场分割为片区一步一步地消灭其中
的敌人。
将己方肃清扫荡标识放置在杀戮区中。每当一名
位于该标识水平 5" 内的己方卡舍津特工对位于
该标识水平 5" 内的特工进行射击时，那名己方
特工的武器拥有“无休”武器规则。在下一个战
略阶段的就绪步骤中，将标识移除。
cards.text_en:
KASRKIN
STRATEGY PLOY
CLEARANCE SWEEP
The Kasrkin advance steadily towards their objectives,
clearing the battlefield of enemies quadrant
by quadrant.
Place your Clearance Sweep marker in the
killzone. Whenever a friendly KASRKIN
operative within 5" horizontally of that marker is
shooting an operative also within 5" horizontally
of that marker, that friendly operative’s weapons
have the Ceaseless weapon rule. In the Ready
step of the next Strategy phase, remove
that marker.

cards.text:
卡舍津
战略计谋
转移位置
卡舍津战士们时刻都在移动，他们迅速穿梭
并前往新的射击位置。
选择一名位于敌方特工 3" 外的己方卡舍津特
工。被选择的那名特工，以及其 3" 内所有位于
敌方特工 3" 外的己方卡舍津特工可以立刻执行
一次无消耗的冲刺行动，具体顺序由您来决定。
您不能在第一个转折点使用该计谋。
cards.text_en:
KASRKIN
STRATEGY PLOY
RELOCATE
The Kasrkin are always on the move, advancing swiftly
across the battlefield to take up new firing positions.
Select one friendly KASRKIN operative that’s
more than 3" from enemy operatives. That
operative, and each other friendly KASRKIN
operative that’s both within 3" of that operative
and more than 3" from enemy operatives, can
immediately perform a free Dash action in an
order of your choice. You cannot use this ploy
during the first turning point.

cards.text:
卡舍津
交战计谋
把握先机
卡舍津是勇猛果断的部队，就算是在混乱的
战场上也能够迅速且准确地展开行动。
在交战阶段开始时使用本交战计谋。一名己方
卡舍津特工可以立即无消耗执行一个 1AP 的行
动，但是不能在那次行动中进行移动。如果您拥
有先手权，那么不能使用本计谋。
cards.text_en:
KASRKIN
FIREFIGHT PLOY
SEIZE THE INITIATIVE
Kasrkin squads are bold and decisive, acting with speed
and clarity even in the confusion of battle.
Use this firefight ploy at the start of the Firefight
phase. One friendly KASRKIN operative can
immediately perform a 1AP action for free, but it
cannot move during that action. You cannot use
this ploy if you’re the player with initiative.

cards.text:
卡舍津
交战计谋
掩护撤退
如果一名卡舍津战士需要进行后撤，他的友
军们会提供压倒性的火力支援来进行掩护。
在一名己方卡舍津特工执行后撤行动时，如果
其 6" 内存在另一名对其可见且不位于敌方特工
控制范围内的己方卡舍津特工，那么您可以使
用本交战计谋。在进行后撤的己方特工完成移动
后，后撤行动结束之前，那个另一名己方特工可
以立即执行一次无消耗的射击行动（您可以将其
改成交战命令）。
cards.text_en:
KASRKIN
FIREFIGHT PLOY
COVER RETREAT
Should a Kasrkin soldier need to retreat, their allies may
lay down a withering barrage of covering fire.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly KASRKIN
operative performs the Fall Back action while
visible to and within 6" of another friendly
KASRKIN operative that’s not within control
range of enemy operatives. After that friendly
operative has finished moving, but before
that Fall Back action ends, that other friendly
operative can immediately perform a free Shoot
action (you can change its order to Engage to
do so).

cards.text:
卡舍津
交战计谋
消灭目标
一名暴露在外的敌方特工被指定成为了首要
目标，特工举起了手中的武器并对其进行了
一番连射。
当一名己方卡舍津特工进行射击时，在您掷出
攻击骰后使用本交战计谋。如果目标无法保留任
何掩护豁免或者受到扫描（参见侦察兵），那么
您可以重掷自己的任意攻击骰。
cards.text_en:
KASRKIN
FIREFIGHT PLOY
NEUTRALISE TARGET
Designating an exposed enemy operative as a priority
target, this operative levels their weapon and fires a
volley of rounds.
Use this firefight ploy after rolling your attack dice
for a friendly KASRKIN operative, if it’s shooting
an operative that either cannot retain any cover
saves or is being scanned (see RECON-TROOPER).
You can re-roll any of your attack dice.

cards.text:
卡舍津
交战计谋
寸土不让
卡舍津战士们的一生都在保卫着帝国，击退
来自恐惧之眼的可怕敌人，他们在敌人面前
展现出不可动摇的纪律性。
在一名己方卡舍津特工的激活期间，或者在交
战阶段结束时使用本交战计谋。选择一个己方任
务标识或者目标标识。直到激活结束或者下一个
转折点开始前（根据上述情况决定)，如果争夺
那枚标识的己方卡舍津特工的 APL 总和为 2，
并且与争夺相同目标的敌方特工的 APL 总和相
同，那么己方卡舍津特工将控制那枚标识。
cards.text_en:
KASRKIN
FIREFIGHT PLOY
GIVE NO GROUND
Hardened by a lifetime spent defending the Imperium
from the horrific denizens of the Eye of Terror, the
Kasrkin demonstrate unwavering discipline in the face
of the enemy.
Use this firefight ploy during a friendly KASRKIN
operative’s activation, or at the end of the
Firefight phase. Select one of your mission
markers or an objective marker. Until the end of
that activation or until the start of the next turning
point respectively, if the total APL of friendly
KASRKIN operatives that contest that marker
is 2, and the total APL of enemy operatives
that contest it is the same, friendly KASRKIN
operatives control that marker.

cards.text:
卡舍津
阵营装备
前握把
前握把被安装在了枪管下方，能够提供一定
的稳定性，并且提升了武器在近距离战斗中
的灵活性。
每当一名己方卡舍津特工对位于其 3" 内的特
工进行射击时，其数据卡上的远程武器拥有“精
准 1”武器规则（名称中带有“手枪”的武器除
外，例如高能激光手枪和等离子手枪的所有武器
资料)。
cards.text_en:
KASRKIN
FACTION EQUIPMENT
FOREGRIP
Fitted under the barrel of the gun, this foregrip helps
stabilise the bearer’s weapon, improving its handling at
close range.
Whenever a friendly KASRKIN operative is
shooting an operative within 3" of it, ranged
weapons on its datacard (excluding weapons
that include ‘pistol’ in their name, e.g. hot-shot
laspistol, all profiles of a plasma pistol, etc.) have
the Accurate 1 weapon rule.

cards.text:
卡舍津
阵营装备
长距离瞄具
这件武器安装有用于精确射击的瞄准镜，大
幅度提升了远距离射击的精准度。
每当一名己方卡舍津特工对位于其 6" 外的特工
进行射击时，那名己方特工的高能武器拥有“集
中”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
KASRKIN
FACTION EQUIPMENT
LONG-RANGE SCOPE
This weapon is fitted with a marksman’s scope, enabling
great accuracy even at long range.
Whenever a friendly KASRKIN operative is
shooting an operative more than 6" from it, that
friendly operative’s hot-shot weapons have the
Saturate weapon rule.

cards.text:
卡舍津
阵营装备
卡迪亚圣物
这些个人的小物品能够让卡舍津战士们想起
自己失落的故乡，以及他们战斗的理由。
每个转折点限一次，当一名己方卡舍津特工进
行射击、近战或反击时，如果您掷出了两次或更
多失败，那么您可以将其中一次失败舍弃，并将
另一次失败作为普通成功进行保留。
cards.text_en:
KASRKIN
FACTION EQUIPMENT
RELICS OF CADIA
Small personal effects remind the Kasrkin of their
homeworld, those they have lost, and that which they
fight for.
Once per turning point, when a friendly
KASRKIN operative is shooting, fighting or
retaliating, if you roll two or more fails, you can
discard one of them to retain another as a normal
success instead.

cards.text:
卡舍津
阵营装备
格斗匕首
在需要进行肉搏时，卡舍津战士们会使用格
斗匕首来消灭敌人。
己方卡舍津特工装备有以下近战武器：
名称攻击命中伤害
格斗匕首 3 4+ 3/4
cards.text_en:
KASRKIN
FACTION EQUIPMENT
COMBAT DAGGERS
When close combat is required, the Kasrkin turn to their
combat daggers in order to silence the enemy.
Friendly KASRKIN operatives have the following
melee weapon:
NAME ATK HIT DMG
Combat dagger 3 4+ 3/4
